BluePearl Pet Hospital Oak Creek - serving greater Milwaukee and beyond.
With locations in Oak Creek, Port Washington and Glendale, BluePearl Pet Hospital – formerly known as Lakeshore Veterinary Specialists – provides specialty and emergency pet care throughout southeast Wisconsin, northern Milwaukee and northern Illinois.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
Our specialists have the knowledge and advanced training necessary to handle even the most complex cases, while our highly trained emergency doctors are equipped to handle all your emergency care needs.
Specialty care
We work in partnership with your pet’s primary veterinarian to diagnose and treat complex illnesses and injuries, with the goal of providing the best quality of life. We take the time to understand your pet’s specific condition and discuss every possible treatment option with you during a detailed consultation. Our specialty clinicians are experts in their fields, with years of extensive training and experience working on a wide variety of cases.

Core values.
At BluePearl, we have devoted ourselves to delivering the highest quality advanced medicine with a team of board-certified veterinary specialists and residency-trained veterinarians. Add in a group of exceptionally devoted and experienced technicians and client care specialists, and you’ve got a recipe for extraordinary care.
Pet owners.
At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.
Have questions prior to your visit? We’re happy to help. Contact our hospital team at

Testimonials.
“My pit bull mix named Bella had ingested stuffing from a blanket (my boyfriend and I put a soft blanket in her kennel to help keep her warm at night and she chewed a hole through it). Within 42 hours she was vomiting straight cups of blood. She refused to eat, had no energy, and was completely unlike her energetic goofy self. My boyfriend was working out of town a few states away when she got sick, we both were panicked and didn’t know what to do.
After a handful of peoples’ suggestions and plenty of research, I took Bella to BluePearl in Oak Creek. Not only did Bella absolutely love every staff member, but within days she was completely back to normal. During those few days I was extremely nervous, worried sick, and just depleted, but the staff at BluePearl ALWAYS were there to reassure me and always kept Bella’s health as their top priority. They were able to give my dog back the life she had while also giving my boyfriend and I plenty of tips, reassurance, and cost-friendly treatments for our girl. Our lives would have been completely flipped if it weren’t for BluePearl!”
–Alexandria B.
